overview.description: The 21Shares Solana Staking ETF (TSOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund that seeks to track the price performance of Solana (SOL), less expenses and liabilities, while also seeking to earn additional SOL from staking rewards. TSOL was launched on Nov 18, 2025 and is issued by 21Shares.
